newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Comfort to buy into Tye Soon.
newsitem.headline: Comfort to buy into Tye Soon.

text.p: Comfort Group will take 10 percent of Tye Soon's enlarged share capital, an official of Standard Chartered Merchant Bank Asia Ltd, said on Monday.
The official, whose bank is underwriting Tye Soon's initial public offer (IPO), said Comfort had undertaken to buy 4.97 million new shares and 18.97 million vendor shares at Singapore $0.31 each.
David Chong, a senior manager of corporate finance at the bank, told a news conference the purchases were strategic placement shares and outside the IPO.
According to Ong Hock Siang, Tye Soon's chairman and managing director, there was a synergy between the two companies.
"Comfort is a transpport company and Tye Soon is in auto components. Comfort has a strong presence in China and we are anxious to go into China," he said.
